Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EIGC_BLE_Debug_v1
Objects.description: BMD-345 radio link debug. This is the secondary telemetry channel to the drone, specified to about 1000 m, over which the platform centre position and velocity are sent so the drone can close on the platform until the IR landing system acquires it

variables.name: bleStatus
variables.description: State of the module and of the link to the drone

variables.name: linkState
variables.description: Connection state of the drone link

variables.name: rssi
variables.description: Received signal strength of the drone link

variables.name: droneAddress
variables.description: Bluetooth address of the connected drone

variables.name: droneDistance
variables.description: Distance from the platform centre to the drone, from the position the drone reports back. Sanity check on whether the link range matches the geometry

variables.name: linkUptime
variables.description: Time the current drone connection has been up

variables.name: connectCount
variables.description: Drone connections established since power on

variables.name: disconnectCount
variables.description: Drone connections lost since power on

variables.name: telemetrySent
variables.description: Platform position and velocity updates sent to the drone

variables.name: uartTxPackets
variables.description: Packets sent to the BMD-345 over the module UART

variables.name: uartRxPackets
variables.description: Packets received from the BMD-345 over the module UART

variables.name: uartErrors
variables.description: Framing, overrun and protocol errors on the module UART

variables.name: lastTelemetryAge
variables.description: Time since the last platform update was accepted by the module

variables.name: moduleVersion
variables.description: Firmware version string reported by the BMD-345
